items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: And he played up in -- he played with us. ... He asked me to stay to listen to his band... I stayed there and made his rehearsal with him and everything and I caught his group

ctx.x: But after leaving the band, I think it got to him this way, too. I think he still thinks he should be in there, you know? And he and Sonny, [Payne] Gary, remind me of each other. They always -- Sonny always walk around and said he was -- he had the band before -- Duke stole his band from him.
